hotels_results = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter the hotels based on the new amenity requirements (gym and wifi)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_results,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to the cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_st_louis", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest hotel to the City Museum attraction
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest results to the cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_to_city_museum", value=nearest_results)
